name: finite_partition_permutation_of_fiber_card
lines: p b : Fin n → Fin q
h : ∀ (t : Fin q), {v | p v = t}.card = {v | b v = t}.card
⊢ ∃ σ, ∀ (v : Fin n), p (σ v) = b v
E : (t : Fin q) → { v // b v = t } ≃ { v // p v = t } := fun t => Fintype.equivOfCardEq ⋯
⊢ Fintype.card { v // b v = t } = Fintype.card { v // p v = t }

steps.tactic:
classical
let E : ∀ t : Fin q, { v // b v = t } ≃ { v // p v = t } := fun t =>
  Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by simpa only [Fintype.card_subtype] using (h t).symm)
exact ⟨Equiv.ofFiberEquiv E, Equiv.ofFiberEquiv_map E⟩
